scenes.promptText: Korean language learning classroom short-form video scene. The teacher smiles warmly and gestures gently with one arm pointing toward the chalkboard. The chalkboard shows a fill-in-the-blank sentence: '저녁에는 ___에서 쉽니다.' and below it 'I relax at ___ in the Evening.' and 'Jeonyeok E Neun __ Eseo Swip Ni Da.'
